name: AGLU: Affine-Gated Linear Unit
tagline: GLU-shaped MLP whose gating sigmoid uses a learnable per-channel affine transform of the gate stream.
init_recovers: Plain sigmoid-GLU (SwiGLU/GeGLU style) when γ=1, β=0.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to SwiGLU/GeGLU which apply a fixed nonlinearity (SiLU or GELU) to W₁x, AGLU uses a sigmoid gate with a learnable per-channel affine pre-activation γ⊙(W₁x)+β; same parameter budget except for the two extra hidden-dim vectors, plus LR override 7e-4.

name: Adaptive-Swish MLP
tagline: Standard 4× MLP with a Swish gate whose β is a single learnable scalar (plus learnable bias).
init_recovers: SiLU MLP (β-Swish, β=1) at α=1, β=0.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the fixed GELU activation with a single-scalar learnable β-Swish (h·σ(αh+β)) at the same 4× expansion, no GLU branch — strictly more parameter-efficient than SwiGLU/GeGLU but adds a per-MLP scalar tuning of activation steepness.

name: Squared-SiLU GLU (NSS-GLU)
tagline: GLU with a squared-and-normalised SiLU gate at hidden width 2·n_embd, preserving the 4× parameter budget.

key_hyperparams.name: gate_norm
key_hyperparams.role: fixed scalar to keep activation scale ≈ SwiGLU

init_recovers: Approximately SwiGLU at small g (SiLU(g)²/1.27 ≈ 0.79·g·σ(g) for moderate g).
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the SiLU/GELU gate of SwiGLU/GeGLU with the squared SiLU gate SiLU(g)²/1.27 at hidden_dim = 2·d (same 4× param budget); the squared, always-positive gate is sharper than SwiGLU and the 1.27 normaliser keeps the activation scale matched.

name: Adaptive Squared GELU (ASG)
tagline: Sigmoid-gated MLP with a single learnable interpolant between GELU and GELU·h, plus a hidden-dim LayerNorm.
formula: $$h = \mathrm{GELU}(W_1 x),\quad \tilde{h} = h\,\bigl(1 + s\,(h - 1)\bigr),\quad y = W_o\bigl(\mathrm{LN}(\tilde{h}) \odot \sigma(W_g x)\bigr)$$
diff_from_baseline: Adds two pieces on top of GeGLU: a single learnable squash s that interpolates h vs. h² in the activation branch, and a LayerNorm on the hidden activations — the named baselines have neither a squash blend nor an internal LayerNorm.
